failure_reason: Entire leroymerlin.fr origin returns HTTP 403 (Varnish/Fastly edge, 'Error 54113') to every request, confirmed independently this session across all three access tiers: (1) direct Python requests to robots.txt -> 403; (2) curl_cffi impersonate='chrome124' to homepage -> 403 identical Varnish body; (3) Claude-in-Chrome real browser navigation to both /recherche?query=animalerie and the bare homepage / -> both loaded as '403 Forbidden' pages. This matches the prior Home-Decor pass (archive c147, status=partial) which exhausted 20+ curl_cffi TLS-fingerprint profiles, r.jina.ai, translate.goog, WebFetch, and side-door paths (robots.txt, sitemap-index.xml, /v3/search/search.do) with the same identical 403, and found no AAAA record for an IPv6 route around it -- indicating an IP/ASN or geo-level block at the Fastly edge, not a bot-fingerprint challenge. robots.txt (recovered via Wayback in the prior pass) carries no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai-specific disallow, so this is a network/WAF block rather than a bot-policy opt-out, and Claude-in-Chrome tier-3 access was legitimate to attempt -- it also failed, confirming the block is IP/network-level and not specific to the HTTP tooling.
notes: Per this brief's Rule 1, web.archive.org is explicitly barred as a substitute for reaching the site (no 'Wayback-for-structure' allowance in this brief, unlike the Home-Decor brief the prior pass operated under), so no attempt was made to reconstruct a Pet Care / animalerie category tree from Wayback snapshots -- doing so would only produce qty:null placeholder rows with no way to verify the site's own current category structure or confirm Pet Care exists as a section at all, which is not useful over simply reporting blocked. No rows emitted: zero verified categories, zero verified absence. Recommend a later attempt from a different network/IP/ASN if the origin-level block lifts.
